featured_reviews.name: Ruchit Barodia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Earth Café, Churchgate feels like a quiet pause button in the middle of Mumbai’s relentless rhythm. Tucked away yet perfectly placed, this café welcomes you with an earthy charm that instantly soothes the senses. The moment you step in, you’re greeted by a calming blend of natural tones, soft lighting, and a thoughtfully curated space that feels both modern and grounded—true to its name.

The ambience strikes a beautiful balance between cozy and classy, making it ideal for everything from relaxed conversations to peaceful solo time. Whether you’re catching up with a friend, working on your laptop, or simply enjoying a slow meal, Earth Café creates an atmosphere that encourages you to linger a little longer.

The food is where the café truly shines. Every dish feels fresh, wholesome, and crafted with care. From vibrant salads and nourishing bowls to indulgent yet guilt-free desserts, the menu caters wonderfully to health-conscious diners without compromising on taste. The beverages—especially their coffees and refreshing coolers—are well-balanced and thoughtfully prepared, making them perfect companions to the food.

What stands out most is the attention to detail: warm service, beautifully plated dishes, and a sense of calm that’s rare in the heart of South Mumbai. Earth Café isn’t just a place to eat; it’s an experience—one that leaves you feeling lighter, happier, and eager to return.

A true gem at Churchgate, perfect for those who appreciate good food, serene vibes, and mindful living.

Am a Sequel fan. Dont miss the place.  Love it.

featured_reviews.name: Burjiz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Canara Juice Centre is one of those old classic Mumbai spots that some locals have known about for years. It has built a strong reputation as a go-to place for fresh fruit juices and shakes, especially among people who know the Fort area well.

The place offers a wide variety of juices, milkshakes, and fruit combinations, and the quality and freshness have been very good.

One of my recent favourites here is the Mango Kulfi Shake, which is rich and flavourful. Older favourites of mine include the grape juice and anar (pomegranate) juice, both of which are refreshing and well prepared.

What makes Canara Juice stand out is the sheer range of options available and the fact that the drinks are made fresh to order. Whether you’re looking for something simple and refreshing or a thicker shake, there are plenty of choices to pick from.

Overall, it remains a reliable and well-known stop in Fort for anyone looking for good quality fresh juices and shakes. Definitely worth a visit if you're in the area.

customer_updates.name: SMRUTISIKHA PRADHAN
customer_updates.text:
One of Mumbai's most iconic and historic cold drink shops near CSMT.
• Serving refreshing drinks for generations and known for its famous Kala Khatta sherbet.
• Located opposite Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus and a favorite stop for travelers and locals alike.
• The Kala Khatta drink has the perfect balance of sweet, tangy, and salty flavors, making it extremely refreshing.
• The shop is believed to be over 100 years old and is considered one of the oldest establishments of its kind in Mumbai.
• Besides Kala Khatta, they also serve a variety of traditional sherbets and refreshing drinks.
• Simple, nostalgic, and a true part of Mumbai's street-food heritage.
• A must-visit for anyone who wants to experience an authentic old-Mumbai refreshment.
Overall: Refreshing taste, rich history, and a classic Mumbai experience. Highly recommended

featured_reviews.name: Kiara Soni
featured_reviews.review_text:
​⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Board Games & Brilliant Bites!
​If you are looking for a place with amazing fusion food, fantastic drinks, and a super fun vibe, this spot is an absolute winner. They even have board games to keep you entertained while you wait for your food!
​🍽️ What We Ordered:
​Mexican Beans with Paneer Tacos: A fantastic twist! The paneer went beautifully with the beans, and the fresh salsa and sour cream tied it all together perfectly.
​Steamed Bao with Crumbed Cottage Cheese Batons: This was a standout dish. The crunch of the sriracha-drizzled cottage cheese batons paired with the tang of the radish kimchi inside a soft bao was pure genius.
​Jalapeño Poppers: Golden, crispy, and oozing with flavor—the perfect crowd-pleasing appetizer.
​Lord of Mai Tai’s (Drink): Absolutely refreshing and beautifully crafted. It paired amazingly well with the spicy, flavorful food.
​🎲 The Vibe:
​Everything we tried was top-notch. The addition of board games makes it the perfect place to unwind with friends, play a few rounds, and enjoy an incredible meal.
​Highly recommended for your next weekend hangout!

featured_reviews.review_text: The café is located at a very prime spot near Marine Drive and is easily accessible on foot. While the staff wasn’t particularly warm or friendly, the food was decent. featured_reviews.review_text:
This random find on maps was a hit. Love the fact that it’s a cafe bar, full points for cafe vibes. There is no loud music, great food, service and could grab a small discount too.

We tried a bunch of different things and nothing was disappointing. And above all, it was one of the best LIITs I got recent times. I would highly recommend this place!

featured_reviews.name: Harry Smith
featured_reviews.review_text: The Cafe has plenty of space, the atmosphere is relaxed, stay for as long as you like feel comfortable and the food is really good. I went back 3 times to read, refresh and cool off. My favorites are the blueberry oatmeal, and fig smoothie. The oatmeal was especially good and something I'd like to learn how to make myself. Chandan kumar served me each time and is a very good host, providing a relaxing space i wanted to come back to. Also a very good ice cream place is around the corner natural icecream...

featured_reviews.name: Meeru
featured_reviews.review_text: I'm obsessed with this spot! It's my go-to destination, and for good reason. Every time I try something new, I discover another comfort food favorite. Whenever I'm at Marine Drive, I always end up here, because their mouthwatering, delicious food is irresistible. The service is consistently amazing, and it's become a staple for me - I've lost count of how many times I've visited! Whether I'm with friends, family, or flying solo, this place always delivers. Plus, they have a great selection of games, making it the perfect spot to hang out and enjoy incredible food. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Nidhi Tamboli
featured_reviews.review_text:
We randomly stepped into this café during heavy rain, and it turned out to be one of the best decisions! The ambience was extremely pleasant, peaceful, and calming, making it a perfect spot to relax and unwind. The service was warm and attentive, adding to the overall great experience.

We tried Garden Fresh Pizza, Peri Peri French Fries, Kaitlyn’s Pizza, Red Bull, Hot Chocolate, and Roasted Tomato Basil Soup – and everything was absolutely delicious. Each dish was well-prepared, flavorful, and satisfying.

This café is a wonderful place to spend quality time with friends or loved ones. The cozy corners, books, and games add a fun and homely touch, while the food and service make the whole experience even better. Whether you want a quiet, relaxed afternoon or a lively evening with good company, this spot fits both perfectly. Truly a blend of comfort, flavor, and warmth!

featured_reviews.name: Reneé Pereyra Elías
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nice place, good atmosphere.
The food was nice. It has a lot of options from foreign countries, like pizzas, pastas and burgers, which were not particularly appealing to me as a tourist because I wanted Indian food, but I presume this is how they target the local market. The Indian food choices were few but tasty. However, maybe the ratio quality: price wasn’t the best.
There was a nice selection of wines, which were good.
The atmosphere was nice.
Service was okay.
Very good location.

featured_reviews.name: BSai Ritesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited The Cage Mocking Bird recently and had a really good time!
Drinks & Food: We tried their mocktails, which were super refreshing, especially the watermelon-based one. The bruschetta was also tasty and had a nice balance of flavors.
Ambience: The place has a very cozy and relaxed vibe, perfect for hanging out with friends late into the night.
Experience: One of the highlights is the number of board games and books available-you can just sit back, sip your drink, and play for hours. It makes the cafe feel warm, interactive, and different from most others.

Overall, a fun spot to chill with good food, games, and conversations. Definitely worth revisiting!
